model.name: google/gemma-3-4b-it
model.usage: Coordinator-only, one best-effort triage call per case (cross-checks customer free-text claim against the deterministic assessment); does not influence primary_issue, financial_resolution, or evidence_ids
model.note: Gemma 2 9B / Gemma 3 9B ('Gemma 9B') is no longer served by Google AI Studio or OpenRouter (verified via their model-list APIs, both 404 on gemma-2-9b-it/gemma-3-9b-it as of run_date). gemma-3-4b-it is the closest available Gemma model with a disclosed parameter count under the cap.

decision_logic.rationale: primary_issue / responsible_party / financial_resolution / evidence_ids are computed by direct comparison and arithmetic over CSV-derived facts (see architecture.md section 3), not by LLM judgment, to guarantee correctness and reproducibility

framework.agent_orchestration: custom (no external multi-agent framework); modules communicate via a shared JSON contract, dispatched by agents/coordinator.py

runtime.data_source: data/*.csv (Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist)
